FN-AKV87SQ-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 259
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Representative Debbie Wood
Analyst: Hunter Lapp Date: 03/13/2024
House Bill 259 as introduced would increase election expenses of the judges of probate, funded
from federal or state funds made available for use by the Comptroller, by an estimated minimum
of $35,000 per day, cumulatively, to conduct post-election audits, not to exceed fourteen days,
of at least one precinct in the county after each county and statewide general election, as
required by this bill.
This bill would also increase the administrative obligations of the Secretary of State to post the
audit results to the Secretary's website, report the findings to the Governor and Legislature, and
adopt administrative rules to implement the provisions of this bill.
Page 1

FN-AKV87SQ-2
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 259
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Representative Debbie Wood
Analyst: Hunter Lapp Date: 04/03/2024
House Bill 259 as reported by the Committee on Ways and Means General Fund would increase
election expenses of the judges of probate to be fully reimbursed by the Comptroller, by an
estimated minimum of $35,000 per day, cumulatively, to conduct post-election audits within
thirty days of commencement in at least one precinct in the county after each county and
statewide general election, as required by this bill.
This bill would also increase the administrative obligations of the Secretary of State to post the
audit results to the Secretary's website, report the findings to the Governor and Legislature, and
adopt administrative rules to implement the provisions of this bill.

This bill would also increase the administrative obligations of the Secretary of State to post the

adopt administrative rules to implement the provisions of this bill.
